# iru_device (Data Source)

Reads only assignment metadata for one exact device UUID. It omits names, serial numbers, user email/name, inventory, secrets and operational history. Makes no mutations.

Only the documented exact-UUID GET is used. A missing object reports an error; the lookup does not create a replacement or modify assignments. Omitted API status fields remain null rather than becoming invented defaults.

## Example Usage


```terraform
data "iru_device" "example" {
  device_id = "11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555"
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (String) Exact device record UUID. For ADE this is the ADE-device UUID, not its enrolled MDM record.

### Read-Only

- `asset_tag` (String) Assigned asset tag, or null when empty.
- `blueprint_id` (String) Assigned Blueprint UUID. ADE routing is represented by an empty string.
- `id` (String) Canonical device UUID.
- `tags` (Set of String) Assigned tag names.
- `user_id` (String) Assigned directory-user UUID, or null when unassigned.
